info.description: This course will enhance learners’s knowledge and understanding with corporate strategy and marketing strategy; external and internal decision environment; market position and analysis; corporate and marketing strategic direction; managing, planning and controling marketing strategy.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Apply marketing knowledge to analyzing the roles of market segmentation, defining market positioning as well as the key elements of the operating strategy process.
Analyse the effects of marketing strategy in different levels of company
Assess the marketing strategy of company
Evaluate the company’s marketing strategy, managing, planning and controlling marketing strategy
Create suitable strategic solutions for company’s marketing situations.
